The person in this role will define how AvePoint captures identity state, protects AD and Entra configuration, restores objects and attributes, handles hybrid source-of-authority rules, and supports complex enterprise topologies such as multi-domain forests, multiple forests, trusts, and Entra Connect / Cloud Sync environments. This role is intentionally not the primary owner for AD/Entra threat detection, alert rule authoring, SIEM content, or incident response strategy. AvePoint expects to hire a separate AD/Entra security-focused role for ITDR and security detection. The architect in this role will partner closely with that security role, but the core responsibility here is the backup and recovery architecture: how to safely protect and restore Microsoft identity systems when disaster occurs. The ideal candidate has built, operated, or deeply influenced Active Directory and Entra ID backup/recovery products or services, ideally at a vendor that protects AD, Entra ID, hybrid identity, or directory services at enterprise scale. jobs.description_text: About the role Anthropic’s Life Sciences team is working to make Claude a useful partner across biology and drug development, so that promising science can reach patients sooner. Genetic medicines are one area where we see real potential, particularly for diseases with few or no treatment options. Chemistry, manufacturing, and controls (CMC) often sets the pace in this field. We’re hiring a CMC & Manufacturing Lead to bring deep technical expertise to our team. You’ll guide CMC strategy across a range of genetic medicine technologies, work closely with external partners, and help our researchers and engineers make Claude useful for real CMC work. Much of today’s CMC practice was built for products made at scale for large populations. jobs.title: Data Center Power Generation and Microgrids Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the role Training and serving frontier AI models requires compute infrastructure at a scale and density that pushes past what conventional data center designs were built to handle. The loads involved are large enough — and arrive fast enough — that utility supply alone often can't meet the need on the timeline required, and the step-load behavior of large accelerator clusters creates power-quality and ride-through demands that conventional backup-generation designs weren't built for. Anthropic's Data Center Infrastructure team is responsible for solving that problem: delivering facilities that can be energized early, ride through grid disturbances, and present a well-behaved load at the point of interconnection (POI). As a Data Center Power Generation & Microgrids Engineer, you'll own the behind-the-meter generation and storage architecture for Anthropic's data center portfolio. That means the on-site generation fleet — reciprocating engine gensets, gas turbines, fuel cells — and the battery energy storage systems that buffer load steps and provide ride-through. It means the microgrid layer that ties them together: islanding and resynchronization, black-start, load-shedding, and generation dispatch. And it means the grid side: interconnection studies and agreements, IEEE 1547/2800 compliance, and power quality at the point of interconnection. jobs.description_text: WHY BOX NEEDS YOU Box is evolving in terms of pricing and packaging – taking our more straightforward, seat-based model and augmenting it with API-call-base and AI-driven consumption. The Director, Pricing & Packaging will help Box navigate the shift from traditional enterprise software pricing towards consumption-based pricing tied to AI usage, units, platform activity, costs, and business value. The impact of this leader will be both strategic and operational. They will bring analytical rigor to pricing model design while helping cross-functional teams align around recommendations, tradeoffs, and implementation. Success will depend not only on building the right model, but also on clearly articulating the business context and strategy behind pricing recommendations to senior leaders. This is an individual contributor role reporting into our Vice President, Product Marketing. This role will be hybrid based in our Redwood City, CA global HQ three days per week. YOUR IMPACT AT BOX The Director, Pricing & Packaging will own a strategic and execution-oriented pricing function focused on helping Box modernize its pricing approach. Key responsibilities include: Lead the evolution of Box’s pricing model from a primarily seat-based approach to more complex platform, usage, and AI consumption-based models. Shield’s mission is to secure enterprise content while delivering a seamless user experience, ensuring Box remains the platform of choice for secure Intelligent Content Management. Shield keeps customer content safe by surfacing malware, compromised accounts, and anomalous behavior early, giving administrators the context they need to take proactive action before incidents escalate. The Shield team is hiring Machine Learning engineers to build and scale ML systems that safeguard millions of users and billions of files from ransomware, data exfiltration, insider threats, and emerging AI-based attacks. As part of a fast-paced backend/core team, you’ll collaborate across Box to ship future-proof security capabilities for high-demand use cases. jobs.description_text: The Role: We're hiring one of the first software engineers on our electro-optical team. Today that means long-range EO/IR sensors. In future it could mean sensors on mobile and airborne platforms. Wherever the sensor sits, the job is the software that makes it, and every sensor around it, act as one system. This is a software engineering role first. You don't need to be a camera or computer vision specialist. You do need to be an excellent engineer who is curious about physical systems and understands how real sensors behave: they drift, they disagree with each other, and a field test doesn't care what the simulation said. You'll join a small, elite team that takes its own work into the field. You'll test live, change code live, and see how it holds up on the next flight. The capabilities you build will push the frontier of what these systems can do, and few engineers anywhere get to work this close to the hardware, the mission and the result. We're also changing how we build software. The aim is to take a feature or a new capability and develop as much of it as possible without real hardware, then push it up the chain: through simulation, through hardware in the loop, and on to full end-to-end tests in the real world. Simulation will keep improving, but real hardware will always have the final say. Your impact You'll own the Evidence.com experience agencies use to register, update, and maintain a fleet of hundreds of thousands of TASER devices. This isn't a new product. Executives are engaged in several parts of this work, such as how device logs are presented, so what you improve gets seen. About the team Join our TASER software and data science team, a small and agile group within the TASER pillar at Axon. Everyone on it is technical.
